== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sapphires are multifaceted gemstones that can appear in various forms and colors. While typically known for casting blue light, some specimens exhibit flickering white and green internal lights or a gradient of multiple colors. They can be found as [[natural treasures]], such as those held in metal cages on scripted metal trees, or as round-cut gems roughly the size of a human fist. These stones can serve as vessels for internal constructs and [[scripts]]; however, if the sapphire is cracked or damaged, it may leak [[madra]], potentially causing the internal [[construct]] to lose its structure and eventually dissolve. A sapphire that has lost its internal power may appear dull or dead. Beyond their use as containers, the term is also associated with specific magical manifestations, such as spheres of sapphire [[madra]] and aura or eyes that take on a solid, oceanic blue appearance.}}
